notes.title: Scheduled Race Events survey!
notes.content:
Hi there everyone and welcome to the Wincars Racer Early Access!

It's been only 5 days from launch and we are already setting up the upcoming Scheduled Race Events.

What are the Scheduled Race Events?

In order to gather the maximum number of players in a short period of time (around 1 hour approximately), and play the game as it plays the best, we'll set up one weekly event where all of you are invited.

Question is... what time is the best for this event?

Please do not hesitate to leave your suggestion in the comments tab below!

Greetings from the devs!
